risks.risk: Identity mismatch (not actually the claimed model/brand), which affects parts availability and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the vehicle identification plate/VIN and a close-up of the model/brand badge on the trike (plus a photo of the dashboard/controls).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown 3-wheel trike in used condition (worst-case for parts/fitment).

risks.risk: Tyre condition not truly 'brand new' (could be worn, cracked, or mismatched).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tyres showing tread pattern and sidewall condition (cracks/age marks), plus a photo of tyre brand/model if visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres not guaranteed new (worst-case: tyres may need replacement soon).

risks.risk: Not working / mechanical issues (engine, electrics, brakes, steering alignment).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or start-on-camera), then a short ride or at least brake test and indicator/headlight test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: needs servicing/repair).

risks.risk: Accident damage or frame/structural issues not visible from this single wide shot.
risks.proof: Photos of both sides, underside, and close-ups of suspension mounts, frame welds, and any panel gaps; include a straight-on front and rear alignment photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/needs inspection (worst-case: treat as repair-risk).

risks.risk: Customs/duty documentation may be missing or not verifiable, affecting legality and resale.
risks.proof: Photos/scans of customs/duty receipt and import documents (and any Nigerian registration papers if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as no verifiable documentation (worst-case: buyer bears compliance risk).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the VIN/ID plate and any model/brand badge (close-up, readable).
Send customs/duty documents (receipt/invoice and any import paperwork) showing the item details.
Send close-up tyre photos (tread + sidewall condition) for all three tyres.
Send a start-up video and a short test video showing lights, indicators, horn, brakes, and steering response.
response.reason: From photo 0, the exact model/brand (including the claimed 'Ryker') and working/mechanical condition cannot be verified, and the customs/tyre claims are not provable remotely. To price safely for Abuja, we need the readable ID/VIN/model badge and proof of working condition plus tyre close-ups and documents.
